title: JPMorgan expands digital assets push with Mitsubishi deal as it targets $10bn in daily transactions
title_zh: 摩根大通与三菱交易扩大数字资产推动力度，目标每日交易量达 100 亿美元
summary: Mitsubishi will use JPMorgan digital assets rails for payment solutions. The investment bank aims to double the amount of transactions used by Kinexys. It comes as Wall Street warms to crypto and blockchain technology.
summary_zh: 三菱将使用摩根大通数字资产轨道作为支付解决方案。该投资银行的目标是将 Kinexys 的交易量增加一倍。华尔街对加密货币和区块链技术产生了浓厚的兴趣。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks rise as Trump willing to end Iran war without Hormuz deal
title_zh: 富时 100 实时：股市上涨，因为特朗普愿意在没有霍尔木兹协议的情况下结束伊朗战争
summary: The US president reportedly has assessed that a mission to reopen the strait would push the war beyond his timeline of four to six weeks
summary_zh: 据报道，美国总统评估称，重新开放海峡的任务将使战争超出他的四到六周的时间表

title: Eli Lilly bets on AI drugs in $2.75B deal: What to know
title_zh: 礼来 (Eli Lilly) 在 $2.75B 交易中押注人工智能药物：要知道什么
summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) is bringing artificial intelligence (AI) drugs to the global market in a $2.75 billion deal with Insilico.Defiance ETFs CEO and CIO Sylvia Jablonski and Yahoo Finance Tech Editor discuss.
summary_zh: 礼来公司 (LLY) 将与 Insilico 达成 27.5 亿美元的交易，将人工智能 (AI) 药物推向全球市场。Defiance ETF 首席执行官兼首席信息官 Sylvia Jablonski 与雅虎财经技术编辑进行讨论。

title: Oil Climbs as Trump Threatens War Escalation If No Deal Soon
title_zh: 特朗普威胁如果不尽快达成协议，战争升级，油价上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil prices rose after President Donald Trump threatened attacks on Iran’s energy infrastructure, overshadowing his comments that a deal to end hostilities in the Middle East could be close.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——唐纳德·特朗普总统威胁袭击伊朗能源基础设施后，油价上涨，盖过了他有关结束中东敌对行动可能达成的协议的言论。

title: Inside ‘Project Eagle,’ JPMorgan’s high-wire act to fund EA deal
title_zh: 摩根大通为 EA 交易提供资金的走钢丝行为“鹰计划”
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The post from @realDonaldTrump landed at precisely 7:23 a.m.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——@realDonaldTrump 的帖子于上午 7 点 23 分准时到达。
